collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HEALING, PSYCHOLOGY AND MEDICINE (HEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Healers, herbs, teas, poultices, mushrooms, potions, island magic, listening, breathing, routines and rest. Care for the body and care for the mind, with every kind of healing treated with equal respect. Treatments can help, help a little, do nothing or have side effects. Nobody has to be cured, nobody is mocked, and the villager always decides.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A friend builds a villager with a head cold a steam tent of leaves: stay under the leaves, or say it is too hot.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a heavy head cold. (friend) has built a little steam tent from palm leaves over a pot of hot water full of crushed fragrant leaves. "Sit under it and breathe," says (friend). "It doesn't cure anything. It just feels good." (subject) crawls in. It's hot, damp and smells wonderfully of green things.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) stays in so long that (friend) starts to worry. "Are you alright in there?" "I'm never coming out," comes the muffled reply. "I live here now." When (subject.he/she) finally emerges, pink and dripping, (subject.he/she) can breathe through (subject.his/her) nose for the first time in three days. It lasts about an hour. That's a very nice hour.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: After a few breaths, (subject) bursts out of the tent, gasping. "Too hot! Too hot!" (friend) apologizes and tips some of the water out. The second try is better: warm, not scalding. (subject) sits under it for a while and feels a little clearer. "Next time," (subject.he/she) says, "we start cool and work up." (friend) agrees that's a better system.
